major_cooldowns.name: Colossus Smash
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it the moment it is up and land Bladestorm or Demolish inside the debuff, and keep spending rage so Anger Management brings it back sooner.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 167105 is the cast id; 208086 is the matching self buff and enemy debuff.

major_cooldowns.name: Avatar
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it just before or with Colossus Smash, and take it off cooldown rather than holding it for a perfect line up.

major_cooldowns.name: Bladestorm
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Dump it inside Colossus Smash or Avatar, and do not sit on it waiting for an alignment its own cooldown reduction will never reach.
major_cooldowns.id_note: The guide links Bladestorm as 227847, the Fury version; 446035 is the id cast in the sampled Arms parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Demolish
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it inside every Colossus Smash, either as soon as Colossal Might caps or held to the last seconds of the debuff for extra stacks.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Colossus hero talent; not pressed in the sampled Slayer parses but castable per its tooltip.

major_cooldowns.name: Ravager
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Throw it out in the last moments before Colossus Smash so its ticks land inside the window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 228920 is the Arms cast row; 156287 and 334934 share the name and were not observed as casts.

major_cooldowns.name: Sweeping Strikes
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it as extra targets come up so your single-target hits carry onto another enemy, and precast it ahead of an AoE pull.

major_cooldowns.name: Champion's Spear
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it right after Colossus Smash when the pack needs holding in one spot; its own damage is mediocre.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Resolved by name lookup against WCL game data; not pressed in the sampled parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Potion of Recklessness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Save it for the execute phase inside a fresh Colossus Smash, and pot on the pull too when the fight is long enough for two.

defensives.name: Die by the Sword
defensives.usage_rule: Pop it into predictable physical damage for 30% less damage taken and a huge parry boost.

defensives.name: Rallying Cry
defensives.usage_rule: Call it just before a raid-wide hit so the group takes the damage on a temporary health buffer.
defensives.id_note: 97462 is the cast id; 97463 is the buff the log records.

defensives.name: Demoralizing Shout
defensives.usage_rule: Shout before melee damage goes out to cut what nearby enemies deal to you.
defensives.id_note: Logs carry 1160 as the enemy debuff, and it is also the cast id.

defensives.name: Spell Reflection
defensives.usage_rule: Time it onto a spell aimed at you to bounce it back and take 20% less magic damage.
defensives.id_note: 23920 is the cast id; 385391 is the buff the log records.

defensives.name: Impending Victory
defensives.usage_rule: Press it when you need a top up, since it heals 30% of your health and still deals damage.

rules.description: Keep Rend ticking on your target
rules.action: Refresh Rend before it drops off, and top it up as Colossus Smash comes back.
Hold Bladestorm for the Colossus Smash window, or spend it under Avatar when the smash is far away.
Start Demolish while Colossus Smash is on the target, once Colossal Might caps or in the debuff's last seconds.

rules.description: Avatar lined up with Colossus Smash
rules.action: Fire Avatar shortly before Colossus Smash or inside the window instead of on its own.

rules.description: Open with Charge into Avatar and Colossus Smash
rules.action: Charge in on the pull for the extra rage, then send Avatar and Colossus Smash back to back.

rules.description: Execute replaces Slam in execute range
rules.action: Drop Slam once the target reaches execute range and put that rage into Execute.

rules.description: Spend Sudden Death procs on Execute
rules.action: Turn Sudden Death procs into Executes rather than filling with Slam.
Save Sweeping Strikes for packs so your single-target hits cleave, and precast it ahead of an AoE pull.
Throw Ravager down in the last moment before Colossus Smash so its ticks land in the window.
